caption: A swimmer does front crawl across a pool and reaches the far wall.

sa.check: A swimmer swims front crawl in a pool.
The stroke is front crawl, with the arms coming over one at a time.

pc.expect: The arms come over one at a time and pull through, the legs kick, the head turns to breathe, and the arms bend at elbow and shoulder.
pc.fail: Both arms come over together; or an arm bends mid-forearm; or the legs pass through each other.

pc.expect: Each arm stays attached and the swimmer stays one person.
pc.fail: An arm detaches or vanishes; or a second swimmer appears in the lane; or a limb duplicates.

pc.expect: Each stroke splashes and leaves a wake.
pc.fail: The arms move through the water leaving the surface glassy; or splashes appear where no arm is; or the wake runs ahead of the swimmer.

pc.expect: The body stays at the surface, mostly under the water.
pc.fail: It floats above the water; or sinks and swims along the bottom; or rises out of the pool.

pc.expect: The swimmer keeps their shape and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: They pass through the lane rope; or merge with the wall; or turn into another figure.

pc.expect: The swimsuit and the pool stay the same.
pc.fail: The swimsuit changes colour; or the lane markings shift; or the pool changes.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
